scope.profile: Decoded ACIS straight-curve fields; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted projection also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_pointWithinToleranceOfAcisStraightCurve tests Euclidean distance to the infinite line p0 + t*p1 against a caller-supplied tolerance and returns the raw parameter on acceptance.
scope.tolerance_policy: Tolerance must be finite and nonnegative; no ACIS/modeler default is inferred.
scope.parameter_policy: The raw direction is not normalized and the parameter is not clamped to edge endpoint bounds.
scope.refusal_policy: Unsupported/unresolved curve, zero direction, non-finite point/tolerance, unrepresentable projection/residual, or out-of-tolerance point returns false without changing the output parameter.
non_claims: B-rep validity or native consumer qualification
